fusions.name: Clanging Slam
fusions.desc: Slams a braced wing down in a ring, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Cold Reckoning
fusions.desc: A cold strike that deals 18 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It uses up every other affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Brace Up
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
